title: Darts in Higher Dimensions (with 3blue1brown) - Numberphile
summary: Numberphile talks with Grant Sanderson of 3Blue1Brown about a darts puzzle with a shrinking bullseye. Solving it takes the volumes of high-dimensional spheres, and the answer turns up Euler's number.
why: Used as a friendly example of high-dimensional geometry showing up in a simple problem, and of ball volume shrinking inside a hypercube.

quote.text: There's a nice video about this from Numberphile and 3blue1brown
